terminals.name: backend-api
terminals.command: cd riveredge-backend && export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" UV_LINK_MODE=copy PYTHONPATH=src && uv run aerich upgrade && uv run --extra ocr --extra pdf python scripts/run_dev_server.py

terminals.name: taskiq-worker
terminals.command: cd riveredge-backend && export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" UV_LINK_MODE=copy PYTHONPATH=src RIVEREDGE_TASKIQ_POOL_MIN=1 RIVEREDGE_TASKIQ_POOL_MAX=2 && uv run --extra ocr --extra pdf taskiq worker --app-dir src --workers 1 core.tasks.taskiq_app:broker core.tasks.taskiq_app core.tasks.ai_tasks core.tasks.worker_bootstrap core.tasks.data_backup_handlers

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.command: cd riveredge-frontend && export VITE_BACKEND_HOST=127.0.0.1 VITE_BACKEND_PORT=8200 && npx vite --port 8100 --host 0.0.0.0
